description: Create a new delivery note from a quotation or order confirmation via `POST /delivery-notes?precedingSalesVoucherId={id}`. In introduction, lineItems[].description, and remark, use only Lexware formatting: **bold**, __italic__, and dash-prefixed list items separated by newlines.

body.description: Delivery note JSON body with voucherDate, address, lineItems, totalPrice, and taxConditions. In introduction, lineItems[].description, and remark, use only Lexware formatting: **bold**, __italic__, and dash-prefixed list items separated by newlines.

precedingSalesVoucherId.description: UUID of the preceding sales voucher (quotation or order confirmation) that this delivery note is pursued from.

name: lexware_pursue_delivery_note
title: Pursue to a Delivery Note
